titlePlain: A Security Checklist for a Cluster Before It Goes to
subtitle: Lesson 28 · Kubernetes Security & RBAC

eyebrow: Checking RBAC before you trust it
code:
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o json | \
  jq -r '.items[] | select(.roleRef.name=="cluster-admin") | .subjects[]?.name'

kubectl auth can-i --list \
  --as=system:serviceaccount:payments:billing-reader
caption: Every cluster-admin subject should be a human account you can justify by name — never a forgotten ServiceAccount.

code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
  namespace: payments
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Ingress"]
caption: Kubernetes allows all Pod-to-Pod traffic by default — this has to be created on purpose.
